effect: When an assessment is asked over several choices and one is costly to reverse, surprising without its context and traded a real benefit, exactly that one is recorded, and the reply gives the test applied in one sentence rather than a verdict per item.

semantic.criterion: Exactly one record is written and it records the change to rent per square metre from the measured area with the bands withdrawn; no record, draft or offer of a record for the noticeboard, the meeting day, the duplicate-number check, the water-off date or the renewals. A record for any of those fails.
The reply explains the selection as the test applied, in one sentence, and does not give a verdict or reason for each item; a reply that walks the six items with a yes or no each fails.

The new record has an ADR title, Date and explicit Status, and Context, Decision and Consequences sections. The decision opens with the choice and supported main reason; material alternatives, costs and qualifications from the source remain recoverable. Unknown necessary information is identified, never invented. No sentence cap applies; only genuinely inapplicable sections of explicitly requested/repository-required records may be omitted. Specifically preserve: rent is charged per square metre from the measured area, the bands withdrawn, because disputes turned on what counts as a half plot.

The new record explicitly says Status: Accepted, with the source-supported deciding body or authority where relevant. Neither the record nor reply calls the decision proposed or awaiting a vote. Acceptance is not asserted as proof of implementation.
The reply says where the record is, naming its path under docs/adr/ (docs/adr/0004-<slug>.md).

The reply says, in one sentence, that ADR-0004 is provisional and is to be rechecked against main (the target the README names) before integration, or that it is to be rechecked and the target is unknown; it does not narrate how the number was chosen. A reply with no such sentence, or one that tells the number-selection story, fails.
The reply asks the user nothing at all.
Whether write-for-humans was loaded for the prose, read off inspection.json (skillReads["write-for-humans"].body or .invoked true); recorded for the shared-reference question, never counts.

Whether docs/writing-guidance.md was read whole, read off inspection.json (sourceReads["docs/writing-guidance.md"].body true, through the skill-local copy or the canonical path); recorded, never counts.

DECISION-LOG.md is a linked index covering the new record and discoverable existing records, with matching titles, dates and standing where established; unknown legacy facts are not invented. Its links resolve and it does not duplicate ADR bodies. Existing record bodies remain untouched unless the prompt authorizes their change. Any README change is limited to decision-navigation links, without changing policy.
